1. Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No. 170/2025 dated 08.04.2025 registered at P.S.
Paschim Vihar West for commission of offences under Sections 420/406/467/468/47l/120B/34 IPC.
2. Admittedly, the applicant has already been declared a 'proclaimed person' on 06.01.2026.

3. Learned Senior Counsel for applicant, while acknowledging the abovesaid order of the learned Trial Court, submits that the process had never been served at the correct address and, therefore,
the applicant has already filed a Revision Petition seeking recall of such order which is coming up for hearing before the learned Court of Sessions on 17th instant.
4.

It is submitted that, even, as per the allegations appearing in the complaint, the applicant is,
merely, alleged to be recipient of a sum of Rs. 2.56 lacs which had been transferred to his account by one co-accused Ravi Shanker and there is nothing on record to indicate that he is a part of any
